test.name: How-to question without naming the wiki
test.description: The user asks a generic 'how do I find [record type]' genealogy how-to question without explicitly naming the FamilySearch wiki. search-familysearch-wiki should activate — the FamilySearch Research Wiki is the source for research methods/how-to. This is the search-fs-wiki side of the search-fs-wiki-vs-locality-guide separation: a how-to/method question routes here, while a 'what records exist for [place]' records-availability survey routes to locality-guide (see the reciprocal negative test in each skill).

input.user_message: How do I find German church records for my ancestors?

judge_context: Should activate search-familysearch-wiki and call wiki_search — a generic 'how do I find [record type]' question is a research-method/how-to question, which is search-familysearch-wiki's territory even though the user did not name the FamilySearch wiki
This is a how-to/method question, NOT a 'what records exist for this place and where are they held' records-availability survey (that would be locality-guide)
